title: Lallan Sweets
author: Srishti Chaudhary
blurb: Have you ever travelled across India with your 'friend', competing against your cousins to find a secret ingredient? No? Well, what a shame! But don't worry, because in this book, you get to do just that. So, get ready for a headstrong girl, a long road trip, family chaos, and just a pinch of romance.
